priority_basis: Verify shared rules that travelers encounter in France, Spain, Italy, and other European destinations, then address selected long-haul arrival and baggage gaps. Group membership applies only within each finding's stated legal and territorial scope. Separately listed overseas jurisdictions are not included.

checks: Council Regulation 116/2009 generally requires an export licence when covered cultural goods leave the EU customs territory. Annex I defines the covered categories.
Departure from EU customs territory with covered cultural goods
Check the goods' age, value and category, licensing exceptions, location of the competent authority, route and independent national treasure rules.

Regulation 2019/880 prohibits introduction of covered cultural goods unlawfully removed from their country of creation or discovery. Imports of specified classes require a licence or importer statement.
EU customs territory; covered cultural goods created or discovered outside that territory
European Parliament and Council of the European Union
Check Annex parts A, B and C, age, value, origin, temporary admission exceptions, and national customs procedures.
Personal souvenirs made of protected species can require permits or certificates under EU wildlife trade rules. Personal-effects exceptions depend on the entry or exit circumstances and listing.
External EU wildlife-trade border; personal effects and souvenirs
Check scientific species name, annex, residency, first import or re-export, quantity, and rules of the other countries on the itinerary.
Article 7 prohibits intentionally bringing in species of Union concern, including transit under customs supervision, subject to the regulation's derogations.
Territory within Regulation 1143/2014; species on the Union list; import and customs transit
European Parliament and Council of the European Union
Verify current species listing, effective dates, territorial scope, permit exceptions and national lists. General food and agricultural rules are separate.
Article 7 restricts intentionally keeping, transporting and releasing invasive alien species of Union concern. Some pre-existing noncommercial pet holdings are governed by transitional conditions.
Territory within Regulation 1143/2014; listed species and in-country activities
European Parliament and Council of the European Union
Check the current species list, applicable holding conditions and local wildlife and environmental rules.
The Birds Directive requires Member States to prohibit covered taking of wild birds' eggs and keeping those eggs, including empty eggs. Deliberate nest removal is also covered.
EU territory subject to the Birds Directive; wild birds, nests and eggs
Check national implementation, species, derogations and site-specific rules. Shells, rocks, sand and other natural souvenirs require separate evidence.

EU guidance explains that customs may review quantity and other indicators when deciding whether alcohol or tobacco carried by a traveler is for personal use. Entry from outside the EU has separate allowances.
Travel between territories applying EU excise rules; alcohol and tobacco carried personally
Check route, fiscal territories, age, national thresholds, and any rule specific to vapes, liquids or nicotine products.
Eligible travelers resident outside the EU may obtain a refund on covered goods if they present the items and refund documents to customs on departure within three months of purchase.
Covered purchases in EU VAT territory exported in personal luggage; residency-based eligibility
Check the purchase location, local thresholds, seller participation, last exit office, and customs validation procedures.
The Visa Code generally requires evidence of travel medical insurance when applying for a uniform short-stay visa, with a minimum cover of EUR 30,000 and specified exceptions.
Participating Schengen territory; applicants for a uniform short-stay visa
European Parliament and Council of the European Union, Visa Code Article 15
Check applicant class, visa validity, first intended visit for a multiple-entry application, and consulate documentation. Visa-exempt entry and vaccination requirements are separate.

Article 75 and its implementing decision establish a certificate for covered travel to another participating state with prescribed narcotic or psychotropic medicines needed for treatment. A separate certificate is required for each covered substance and validity is limited to 30 days.
Travel between participating Schengen countries; applicable travelers with prescribed controlled medicine
Check substance and resident eligibility, issuing authority, travel duration, and separate national rules for arrivals from outside Schengen.
The amended Schengen Borders Code preserves national options to require third-country nationals to report their presence or lodging operators to obtain signed registration forms.
Schengen territory; optional national implementation for covered third-country nationals
European Parliament and Council of the European Union
Check national law before inferring any form, duty, deadline or traveler exemption. This evidence records the shared framework only.
Border Force requires all arriving and departing passengers to hold a valid passport or travel document.
Check visa or ETA eligibility, passport requirements and transit separately.
Border Force requires a valid passport or travel document for departing passengers.
Check export declarations, goods and wildlife restrictions separately.
The traveler exemption for accompanied personal-use baggage arriving by sea or air allows up to two vapes, 20 vape accessories and 200 mL of vaping liquid.
Australia; accompanied baggage under the traveler exemption
Check classification, territorial law and carriage instructions separately.
Australian biosecurity guidance uses an origin-specific process and directs travelers who need a cat or dog import permit to BICON.
Australia; imported pet dogs or cats
Australian Department of Agriculture, Fisheries and Forestry
Check origin, individual animal history, qualification, quarantine, and any special approved-origin procedure.

Health Canada describes how visitors can bring eligible personal-use health products. For covered products it generally assesses quantity against a 90-day supply or a single course of treatment, whichever is less.
Canada; visitors importing eligible personal-use health products
Check the product class and original packaging. Controlled substances and cannabis follow distinct rules.
The Canadian border authority states that unauthorized cannabis transport across the border is illegal, including for products containing CBD and medical cannabis.
Check product classification, authorization and transit law. Domestic possession follows separate rules.
UK passenger customs guidance lists banned goods and goods requiring licences or permits. It distinguishes rules involving Great Britain and Northern Ireland.
UK accompanied goods within the relevant route and customs regime
Check region, origin, contemporary food restrictions and item-specific permissions.
UK guidance on taking controlled medicines out of the country calls for a prescription or letter with specified details. It directs travelers to check the destination country's rules.
UK departure with personal medicine containing a controlled drug
Check the person's residence, substance schedule, exact requirements for the intended duration, and transit and destination rules.
The UAE tourism ministry distinguishes GCC travel-document admission, visa-on-arrival eligibility and travelers who need a visa in advance.
UAE tourist admission; passport and nationality dependent
UAE Ministry of Economy and Tourism
Check the actual passport, nationality, sponsor, emirate and transit itinerary.
The Emirates Drug Establishment publishes a personal-use medicine import permit service and documentation requirements for covered controlled medicines.
UAE; covered medicines carried for personal use
Check the medicine and document requirements, and whether advance approval is needed for the person's route and status.
The Health Sciences Authority identifies purchase, possession and use of vaporisers as prohibited, including rules for vaporisers containing etomidate and its analogues.
Check current product and penalty provisions and separately verify import restrictions.
Singapore's immigration authority distinguishes prohibited, controlled and dutiable passenger goods and identifies the need for approval for controlled items.
Check commodity and authorizing department, declarations and duties.
The Health Sciences Authority distinguishes medicines that can be carried for personal use without approval, products needing prior approval and products that cannot be carried.
Check active ingredient, quantity, documentation and whether a family member is carrying it.
Singapore's health ministry states that quarantine can apply to travelers with recent exposure to yellow fever endemic countries who lack a valid vaccination certificate.
Singapore; traveler health controls triggered by itinerary
Check current country list, lookback period, transit thresholds and certificate timing with the arrival authority.
New Zealand Customs uses the New Zealand Traveller Declaration to identify accompanied goods that must be declared and describes the passenger clearance process.
New Zealand arrivals by air; passenger baggage
Check quantity, duty and restricted items, whether arriving by air or sea, and distinct biosecurity rules.
French Customs distinguishes national certificates or temporary exit authorizations from the EU export licence. Some temporary admission and short-period holdings have exceptions.
Cultural goods leaving the French customs territory
Verify item category, age, value, prior admission, route and paperwork.
French government guidance identifies bans on vaping in enclosed public transport, establishments for minors and certain shared enclosed workplaces.
Check facility-specific and local restrictions and rules for smoking separately.
Spain's historical heritage law treats qualifying archaeological finds as public property and requires immediate notification of accidental finds to the competent administration.
Spain; accidental finds within the scope of Law 16/1985, Article 44
Check which regional authority receives notifications and any additional local requirements.
Italy's civil aviation authority advises passengers carrying medicine in the cabin to have their prescription available for security checks.
Italian airports; passenger cabin screening for medicines
Check current airport and airline guidance, liquid exemptions, and separate customs import rules.
Estonian Customs allows certain medicines for the traveler or their accompanying animals, subject to applicable substance and documentation rules.
Estonian arrivals and departures with personal medicines
Check medicine type, quantity, prescription or agency authorization, and route.

Latvia's revenue service publishes quantity-based duty-free passenger allowances for tobacco and other excise goods and a frequency rule of once every 30 days for the allowances described on its excise page.
Latvia; covered accompanied excise goods, route and mode dependent
Check external versus internal EU routes, mode, quantity, age and special cases for specific products.
Latvia publishes a cash declaration requirement at EUR 10,000 or equivalent when crossing its EU external border.
Latvia; crossing the EU external border with cash
Check instruments, forms and separate requests or rules at internal EU crossings.
